# Pharmalix

> Conference intelligence platform for medical and scientific congresses — plan agendas, capture insights live, and generate attribution-carrying deliverables across the pre / live / post-conference lifecycle.

Pharmalix helps medical affairs and competitive intelligence teams work through the full conference cycle for events like ESMO 2026, ASH 2026, and ASCO 2027: extract sessions from agendas, plan coverage against KITs and KIQs, capture posters and insights on-site, synthesize endpoints and hypotheses, and export executive summaries with source attribution on every claim.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Pharmalix conference intelligence platform.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): High-level view of the active conference — coverage, insights, and delegate activity.

## Pre-conference

- [Session extraction](/pre/extraction): Extract structured sessions from a conference agenda and persist them to the active conference.
- [Agenda planner](/pre/planner): Multi-select filters (track, company, format, KOL, asset) and drag-and-drop planning of session coverage.
- [KIT / KIQ builder](/pre/kitkiq): Build Key Intelligence Topics and Questions that drive downstream insight synthesis.
- [Hypotheses](/pre/hypotheses): Log competitive and scientific hypotheses with impact, likelihood, and evidence.
- [LBA alerts](/pre/lba): Late-breaking abstract alerts mapped to relevant KITs.

## Live capture

- [Live dashboard](/live/dashboard): Real-time coverage and delegate status during the conference.
- [Poster & session capture](/live/capture): On-site capture of posters and sessions with OCR and page-level attribution.
- [Insights](/live/insights): KIT/KIQ-mapped insights ranked by novelty, impact, and confidence.
- [KIQ tracker](/live/kiq): Progress against each Key Intelligence Question.
- [Collaboration](/live/collab): Real-time comments and mentions across the delegate team.

## Post-conference

- [Synthesis](/post/synthesis): Cross-session synthesis and duplicate reconciliation.
- [Endpoint tables](/post/endpoints): Primary and secondary trial endpoints with statistics.
- [Executive summaries](/post/summaries): Tiered executive summaries by KIT and conference.
- [Deliverable generator](/post/deliverables): Configurable PDF, Word, and PowerPoint exports with source attribution toggles.
